lines.text: God asks Ezekiel whether vine wood can make anything useful, even a rod on which to hang utensils.
The vine wood is cast into the fire, its ends devoured and its middle charred, and it was useless even whole.
God says He will give up the people of Nineveh like vine wood given to the fire for fuel.
God will set His face against them, and they will know that He is the LORD.
God will make the land desolate because the people have acted unfaithfully.
